name: resource-64mib-stream
title: 64 MiB resource stream
summary: Stream a 64 MiB incompressible resource with compression disabled.
description: A single large resource transferred whole, over and over, for a fixed wall-time - the multi-segment bulk mechanism. Each logical transfer is 64 MiB sliced into MAX_EFFICIENT_SIZE segments, sent one at a time, hash-proved, and application-acknowledged before another logical transfer begins. The payload repeats one shared deterministic maximum-size block, allowing Prns to stream with bounded memory while both participants transmit identical bytes. Compression is disabled on both stacks.
conformance: Every sent stream settles, receives its ordered application acknowledgement, and is received with exact application-byte totals and zero failures; each transfer is a sequence of hash-proved segments assembled by original_hash before the whole is counted.
